lines.en: : Aaaah! How is the sun already starting to set?! We’re only five contests in! What time even is it right now?!
: Have you been so absorbed in these ridiculous games that you completely missed the end-of-day bell?
: Yes. Yes, I have. But this is something I should be forgiven for based on how complicated all of these games have been! And increasingly hard to set up too.
: Both of those things are your fault entirely and they are not going to make me feel bad for you.
: Okay! Listen up, girls! We’ve only got three more outdoor competitions to get through before we can head back to the rooms I booked for us tonight.
: You mean the rooms I booked for us tonight.
: Nah. You’re part of the 1%% who’s withholding the country’s wealth from hard-working people like me teaching students in exchange for pennies. Your money is my money.
: Technically speaking, my money is my family’s money. And it was obtained through generations and generations of-
: Bubble wrap and other things. Doesn’t matter. What does matter is the fact that we’ve gotta kick things into overdrive so we can finish up before it gets dark!
: And what better way to do that than with a good ole’ fashioned relay race?! No frills added.
: Based on the rest of the day, I’m a little reluctant to believe there won’t be any “frills.” But hey! I’m ready to go. Especially since I’ve been banned from competing in death ball.
: Sorry, Ayane. But without any idea of what death ball is yet, we figured it would be safest for everyone if you just went back inside for that.
: Cowards! Face your fears!
: Now, if all girls competing in the relay race could make their way to the center circle, we can-
: Oh. You’re already there. Neat.
: It’ll be a pleasure competing against you again, Miku. Here’s to hoping I’ll perform better this time.
: Here’s to hopin’ ‘yer boobs don’t fly off and whack one of us in the face.
: Here’s to hoping they do.
: Here’s to hoping that one day, my peers will be able to see me as more than a walking pair of breasts.
: Gotta fly before ya can walk, Touka. That’s what David Beckham always says.
: You know what else David Beckham always says, Miku?
: “Hi. I’m David Beckham.”
: Right. But also, that floor two is going down and floor one is going to come out victorious, bitches.
: I’m curious about the context in which he would say something like that.
: And I’m curious about why you three think you stand a chance. We have Miku on our team. She’s the fastest girl in the school. Probably.
: It’s not like I’ve measured, but it’s probably true.
: Yeah, but this is a relay race. We all have to participate. Which just means that we stand a chance so long as we beat you and Ayane by enough.
: And I feel quite good about our chances this time as I have never seen you participate in anything athletic, Chika.
: I was chosen for this contest for a reason, Touka.
: You were chosen for the cheer competition for a reason as well and that didn’t really pan out the way it was supposed to. So here’s hoping this time it does, I guess!
: That was a fluke. If we were given more than a few minutes to prepare, Rin and I would have wiped the floor with them.
: Will that be your excuse when you lose this time as well?
: We ain’t gonna need an excuse this time, Kirin. By the time we’re done with ya, you’ll be wishin’ you got chosen for death ball instead.
: I know it’s not what we discussed, but do you mind if I run first, Touka? Then you could move to second and we can have Kirin as our anchor since she’s the only one of us who actually plays sports.
: For the millionth time, so do I. But yes, I have no qualm with that change as it will allow me to compete against Ayane.
: Wait, how do you guys know the order we’re running in?
: Miku posted it on her Instagram.
: Yeah, that tracks.
: Ha. Tracks. Nice.
: So, I guess it’s you and me first, Noriko?
: Sure is! And if I beat you, you must grant me Yumi’s hand in marriage. That is my condition.
: Can I have your sister if I win?
: Sure, so long as you can pry her off of Sensei.
: If I can what?
: Ngh!
: Imani! Can you please stop with the whistle?!
: Aaaah, fuck! I’m sorry again, Miku! I was just trying to restore some order and forgot about your thing. I’ll do better.
: I’m good! No worries!
: Noriko-
: Let’s hold off on having any more discussions for now. Imani already told us we have to kick it into overdrive and I’m pretty sure that whistle was her telling us to line up.
: Oh. Yeah. Yeah, you’re right.
: Come on, Noriko! Show me what you’ve got!
: Sure! Just have to reach into my waistband and-
: Are you really going to run with your knife tucked into your fucking bloomers?!
: Of course! Where else would I put it?
: Ladies and gentlemen! The rules of the contest are simple! For real this time!
: Each team has been given a colored baton that they’ll need to hang onto throughout the duration of the race.
: They’ll run in pairs of two, handing off the baton as they go, and the contest will come to an end once either Miku or Kirin makes it through the finish line!
: As always, the reward will be one point! If floor two wins, they’ll tie the contest at three points apiece. And, if floor one wins, they’ll extend their lead to four points over two!
: Noriko! Chika! Are you ready?!
: Ready!
: Yup!
: Then! Wakana, if you would do the honors. But without the gun so we don’t scare Miku again.
: Bang.
: Do...Do we run now? I don’t know if that means-
: Ngh!
: And with that, Chika’s off!
: Shit!
: Think you can get a head start on me, do you?! I’ve gotten straight A’s in PE my whole life!
: That isn’t impressive! All you have to do is show up and participate to get an A in PE!
: Sure! But you could say the same thing about sociology and people still get degrees in that for some reason.
: We don’t even have that class here! Now, shut up and run!
: Wakana! Any early impression of the race based on the skill and shape of our contestants?
: No.
: Well, luckily for you, I’ve prepared stat and fact sheets for both of them to fill the dead air in the broadcast since running isn’t really an activity that’s easy to just silently watch!
: I do hope that you acquired all of this apparent information legally.
: It was legal-ish! I just had to go spelunking, in a sense.
: Please tell me you did not jump into the sinkhole.
: Okay! I won’t! But what I will tell you is that Noriko has gotten straight A’s in every subject throughout her entire life! It's not just PE!
: Does that help with her running at all? Probably not. But it’s still a cool thing to know!
: What’s my fact, Imani?! I want a fact too!
: Let’s see...Chika...Chika...ah! Here we go! Chika Chosokabe has an undefeated record of 17-0 when it comes to boxing old people!
: I’ve never boxed an old person! Let alone seventeen of them!
: And I got a B in AP English once, so I’m pretty sure she’s just making these things up as she goes. But hey! Beating up seventeen old people is way more impressive than straight A’s!
: It helped that they were all using walkers.
: Chika, how could you?!
: I couldn’t! Well...I mean I could! But I wouldn’t!
: But you did!
: Only hypothetically!
: Noriko! Stop talking and save your breath! I want to win this!
: It don’t matter what strategy y’all use, Kirin! Ya ain’t got a chance against me and Ayane! Right, Ayane?!
: Right! And even though I’ve barely exercised at all lately, I still know I can do this! Egg Time Madness warmed me up!
: So sad we lost Sana, though.
: I’m still...I’m still right here...
: Oh! What’s this?! Could this final burst of speed from Noriko Nakayama be enough to- yes! She’s the first one to hand off the baton! And with Chika just a second behind!
: Things are really heating up now, folks!
: Hey! You’re not supposed to be faster than me! I’m built way more aerodynamically than you! And I’m fit!
: You may be able to defeat me in hand-to-hand combat, but I’ve spent at least an hour on the treadmill every day since I was eight years old! Both my stamina and speed are exceptional!
: Her stamina’s only good cause she’s been gettin’ frisky with those damn horses of hers for an hour every day too!
: Stop being disgusting! The hour I spend with my horses each day is typically for maintenance as opposed to leisure!
: That somehow makes it sound even more gross!
: Why is everyone in this class so perverted?!
: I blame Sensei. He was a bad influence on us.
: But you’ve always been like this.
: Yeah, but now I’m worse.
: Wakana! Want to give us a few facts about-
: No.
: Okay! Looks like it’ll fall on me again, then!
: Just leave my horses out of it, please!
: Understood! But only because your snipers will assassinate me if I don’t.
: Even if you didn’t have any snipers though, it wouldn’t protect me since you’re a three time American sumo champion.
: Sumo is nothing to scoff at! Those are some of the strongest men in the world! They could tear me to pieces if they wanted!
: You know, I think Sensei might have made me worse as well because I definitely interpreted that in a way I wasn’t supposed to.
: Every single one of you is sickeningly lewd!
: You’ll get there one day too, Touka.
: Yeah, maybe all those sumo guys’ll help ya.
: For those of you at home wondering whether or not Ayane will be able to catch up, you’ll be able to rest easy with this helpful statistic — she has never once before lost a race!
: Hey, that one’s true!
: How many races have you been in?!
: She’s been in 4,672,710! Most of which have taken place overseas alongside her cross country captain, Mike Tyson.
: That one’s not.
: Aaah! I’ve had enough of this!
: Wha- Touka?! Don’t speed up! We won’t be able to talk anymore!
: That’s the whole point!
: Wow, look at this! Once again, floor two is taking the lead in the later half of-
: Ack!?!
: Forget that, folks! It looks like Ayane’s taken a tumble!
: Kirin!
: Got it!
: And Kirin’s already off! How is the first floor going to come back from this?!
: Ayane! Get the heck up! It ain’t break time yet, ya friggin’ pansy!
: Phbhbhbt! So much sand...in my mouth! Permission to throw baton?!
: There is no way that can be in line with the rules of-
: Permission granted!
: What?!
: Egg Time Madness!
: Egg Time Madness!
: Hah! Hah! Hah! Hah!
: Go, Kirin! Go! Fight! You’ve got this!
: Stop, Kirin! Stop! There’s a dick behind you! Don’t you want to go, like, spit on it or something?!
: Chosokabe. Detention next Friday.
: What?! Imani! Miss Watabe just gave me detention and I have work that day!
: You have what that day?
: Oh, did I say “work?” I meant...a party. I don't have a job. And if I do, it's definitely not one where I have to wear a somewhat skimpy maid outfit and pretend to flirt with people.
: Ugh, you too?

: Detention sounds like a you-problem, Chika! I’m too busy informing the people that Kirin can type 165 words per minute and has a secret collection of Pringles cans that she keeps underneath her bed.
: The only thing...I keep under my bed...is victory!
: Either she’s lying right now or she has given her vibrator a very peculiar name.
: Ew. She keeps it under the bed? Why not hide it beneath her panties in the top drawer like a real girl?
: But then no one would ever accidentally see it and have to think about her using it on herself.
: Nakayama. One more word and you can join Chosokabe on Friday.
: Nepotism! This is nepotism! Noriko should have detention too! We can be bad girls together!
: Can you two...shut up?! You’re...ruining my focus!
: Hiya, slowpoke!
: Oh, god fucking damn it!
: What were ya sayin’ about “focus” just now? Must’a missed the first part since I was in the zone.
: How the fuck did you catch up so quickly?! Ayane ate shit! We should’ve had this in the bag!
: The only bag you’ll be havin’ is...the one that...the one that losers get after...after they lose!
: That’s not even a thing!
: Well it is now! Because that’s the bag you’ll be-
: Eyes forward, girls! You’re approaching the twist!
: What?! What kind of twist did you-
: Wha-
: How did none of us see this until now?!
: Ayane! Get ‘yer damn banana off my track! This ain’t funny anymore!
: It’s not mine this time, I swear! It’s Imani’s! She said “no frills” but this is clearly a frill!
: MWAHAHAHAHAHA! IT’S BANANA TIME!
: God...you’ve completely lost it, haven’t you?
: That banana is simply too large! They’ll never be able to get around it!
: That’s not true. It’ll probably get sucked into the gaping black hole that is Kirin’s vagina the second she tries to climb over it.
: That’d be extremely impressive, not gonna lie.
: What do we do now? We can’t advance. The banana is just too large.
: Hah...
: Miku? What are you thinking?...
: It looks like...I’m gonna have to jump it.
: But it’s such a large banana! Just look at all the text surrounding it! You’ll never make it out alive!
: Ya know...somethin’ else David Beckham always said was “No banana's too large if ya just believe in yourself.”
: That’s very inspiring and I’m inclined to agree, but still! You’ll die!
: But at least I’ll die the hero of the first floor!
: Miku!
: Nooooooooooo!!!!!!!!!!!!!
: Why didn’t either of us just tell her to walk around it?
: Beats me. But it looks like she figured it out on her own in the end.
: Congratulations, Miku. You’ve passed the hidden ninth obstacle — giant banana. You can finally rest.
: Oh, and you’ve also managed to win the relay race and earn another point for the first floor. The score is now four to two.
: All in a day’s work, Miss Imani. Ain’t no banana too big for Miku Maruyama.
: As proud as I am, I am also your teacher and I do not want you to say things like that to me. Especially in front of Wakana since she’s growing more agitated with me by the day.
: I think it’s more so the fact that you’re becoming worryingly unstable and that I may have to commit you soon.
: See what I mean? She’s so angry now. It’s like she doesn’t even love me anymore.
: Bold of you to assume I’ve ever loved you in the first place with how difficult you make my life on a daily basis.
: She says, despite being allowed to go home and still electing to spend her time here with me.
: Baton please, Miku. I’ve gotta go find Rika before she tries to escape her ultimate duty.
: Ultimate duty?...
: Hah...zero out of two. Your girl’s havin’ a rough day, Yumi.
: I mean...you ain’t the one who has to play a game called “death ball.” For all I know, this could be the last conversation we ever have.
: Good point. Which is why I should probably ask you for advice now since you might be dead in a few minutes.
: Good to know my safety’s at the top of your priority list. Means a lot.
: You’ll be fine. I’m just confused about something.

: Before the race started, I jokingly asked Noriko if I could have her sister as a prize if I beat her in the race and her response was, “If you can pry her off of Sensei.” What do you think that means?
: That...one more person has really shitty taste and actually likes that guy for some reason? Shouldn’t be all that surprising to you at this point, Chika.
: Yumi, do I need to remind you who Noriko’s sister is? It’s Niki. Niki Nakayama. My favorite idol? The girl I have a zillion posters of?
: You mean the one who looks just fuckin’ like her? Yeah. I’m aware of who her sister is, Chika.
: Then...isn’t this weird? Noriko and Sensei go way back because he used to tutor her. It wouldn’t be crazy if he met her sister at some point too, would it?
: Not really, nah.
: But, if that’s true, why wouldn’t he have said anything about it? He knows how obsessed I am with her.
: Well, better question — if this idol girl really is attached to your “boyfriend” like Noriko says, how the fuck will that make you feel?
: I don’t know. That’s why I’m so confused. And I want to ask her more about it but, like...I don’t know. It feels weird. Like I want to know. But I’m also, like...scared? Does that make sense?
: I mean...you ain’t gotta decide this shit right now, do you? She ain’t goin’ anywhere. Not so long as that fuckin’ guy’s livin’ around here at least.
: I guess not...maybe I’ll just ask Sensei about it. I don’t know.
: As a side note, though, I’ve agreed to give Noriko your hand in marriage. You two have my blessing.
: You’ve what?
: Come on, Rika! Just a little bit more!
